question: Which server policy is used to install new Cisco IMC software on a server?
theory: New Cisco IMC (server management controller) software is delivered and applied to a server through its host firmware package, which is the policy in a service profile that governs firmware for server-resident components such as BIOS, CIMC, adapters, and board controllers. There is no separate 'Cisco IMC software policy' or 'BIOS software policy' object in UCS Manager — the host firmware package is the single mechanism used to standardize and push CIMC firmware to managed servers. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Firmware Management, Host Firmware Packages)
